title: Prepare CRAN release v0.3.2
description:
## Summary
- Bump version from 0.3.1.9000 to 0.3.2
- Fix `spam_dataset`: namespace-qualify `torch_float()` and `torch_long()` calls that were missing the `torch::` prefix
- Fix `spam_dataset` test: replace broken `dataloader_make_iter(dataset)` call with direct dataset indexing (consistent with other tests)
- Fix oxford-flowers test: add `skip_if_not_installed("R.matlab")` since it's a suggested dependency

## Test plan
- [x] All 43 existing tests pass
- [x] `spam_dataset` test passes with namespace fix
- [x] `oxford-flowers` test correctly skips when `R.matlab` is not installed

title: Add spam dataloader
description:
This PR refactors the spam_dataloader function and introduces robust unit tests to ensure it meets expected functionality.

Results:

All test cases pass, confirming expected behavior of the dataloader under various scenarios.
Ensures compatibility with the Spam dataset structure and Torch requirements.

title: Spam Data Loader
description:
This PR adds a new data loader for the spam dataset. The data loader allows users to load the dataset directly into torch for training and testing machine learning models.

Changes Made:

Added spam_dataset to torchdatasets.
Created unit tests for the loader.
Updated documentation and examples to include the spam dataset.

Issues:
test cases
1 FAIL
1 WARN
2 PASS

title: Addressed data reading warnings and corrected  .getitem
description: The warnings caused in #11 were due to read::read_csv2 not parsing correctly the data; this is addressed by using base R's read.csv2, without loss of quality to the data. Further tests I conducted showed that the existing .getitem() method would cause errors due to torch::torch_tensor() not being able to read x correctly due to it being a data.frame; this was addressed by enlisting and ensuring all values are numeric.

title: Improvements to bank_marketing dataset
description: Improved initialize() method (it now stores the dataset completely as numeric values, facilitating the workflow) and implemented .getitem() and .length() methods as requested by the {torch} models. The dataset is publicly available from https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/index.php, therefore no Kaggle authentication necessary.
